summary: Iteration 8 backend-only testing for Cargo One newly-added endpoints: POST /api/contact + admin listing, POST /api/newsletter/subscribe + admin listing, and POST /api/auth/me/delete GDPR name scrubbing across users/jobs/bids. All 11/11 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL. No regressions or bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1641 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, jobs, bids, bookings, tracking, admin, marketing) for maintainability. Non-blocking.

delete_me currently anonymises jobs.customer_name / assigned_driver_name / bids.driver_name / reviews.from_name / messages.sender_name — comprehensive. Optional nice-to-have: also scrub bookings.other_party cache if any denormalised name is ever added there in the future.
@app.on_event('startup') / 'shutdown' are deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.109 in favour of lifespan handlers — non-blocking but worth migrating.
seed_data_creation: Test file creates isolated TEST_-prefixed users/emails/jobs per run; test data left in DB (contact messages, newsletter subs, jobs, bids, bookings, suspended users). Safe/prefixed for later cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contact form, newsletter subscription and GDPR delete scrubbing (users + jobs.customer_name + jobs.assigned_driver_name + bids.driver_name) all verified via /app/backend/tests/test_contact_newsletter_gdpr.py. Admin credentials: admin@cargoone.com / admin123. BASE_URL from env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Existing suites (test_account_delete.py, test_booking_fees.py, test_cargoone_api.py, test_phase22_trust_delivery.py, test_quote_and_tracking.py) unchanged.
